High-level:
- Usage: raw token volume increased ~14% MoM; we saw onboarding activity from two additional product squads.
- Open items: final SOW pricing, procurement timeline, and one security questionnaire item (data retention config).

As we discussed, proposed next steps for this week:
1) Procurement: finalize invoice recipient & PO terms (Procurement team) — owner: Maya / Aurelia procurement
2) SOW: Redwood to circulate updated SOW with clarified usage tiers & add-on SKU — owner: Ben (attach v2)
3) Technical: short runbook for onboarding the new squads and recommended batching profile — owner: Marcus
4) Close timeline: target signature by 8/27 if procurement path stays on track — tentative.

Can you confirm procurement cadence and whether the two squads will require dedicated rollout support?

Thanks,

Thanks Sofia — quick update from procurement/ops:

- Procurement: we expect a standard SOW review cycle. Procurement has a standing review every Friday; if we can get SOW v3 by Thursday EOD we should be able to slot it for the 8/14 review. PO issuance typically takes 5–7 business days after approval.
- Squads: both squads (Search & Clinical Insights) want a 1-hour onboarding sync and shadowing during the first 48 hours of traffic. They do not need sandbox environments — they'll use existing staging.
- Security: one outstanding item on retention — legal wants confirmation on retention-by-environment (prod vs. staging). I'll loop in legal if needed.

I'll be on the 8/14 review but may be partial in the afternoon. If you can share the SOW and a short runbook calendar, we can prioritize.

—Maya

Date: Mon, 17 Aug 2026 10:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Aurelia Labs — onboarding runbook & throughput guidance

Ben / Sofia — runbook bullets below; paste into SOW as you see fit.

- Pre-launch: validate model variant selection and quantization profile; confirm tokenization parity with Aurelia test set. (Owner: Marcus)
- Day 0 (onboarding): 1-hr kickoff, walk through auth keys, rate limits, and prefix/KV cache settings. (Owner: Marcus)
- Day 0–3: Shadowing window — Redwood engineer on-call for first 72 hours, pager + Slack channel. (Owner: Marcus)
- Ramp plan: start at 10 RPS, increase 2x every 24 hours pending error < 1% and latency < 300ms p95. (Owner: Marcus)
- Escalation: Jordan to handle billing/pricing exceptions; Ben to handle commercial questions; Sofia to coordinate exec alignment.

Also flagged a small pricing question: if they hit 5M tokens/month on embeddings, we need explicit approval for the additive discount tier. Jordan / Ben — can you confirm whether approvals exist for mid-quarter discount exceptions?

Marcus Lin
Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference
